recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群中小型「小圓藍細胞」形成鬆散的黏合團，核質比高、染色質細緻顆粒狀、細胞質稀少淡藍且核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding），在兒童背景下提示轉移性視網膜母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate round blue cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Round to angulated nuclei showing nuclear molding
Finely granular, stippled chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Syncytial arrangement without cytoplasmic granules; background red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate round cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, scant pale cytoplasm, nuclear molding, finely granular stippled chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli. The clustering and molding favor a non-hematopoietic small round blue cell tumor over leukemia. In a child with a history of retinoblastoma, findings are consistent with metastatic retinoblastoma; immunohistochemistry (e.g., synaptophysin, CRX, loss of RB1) and exclusion of other small round blue cell tumors are advised.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma cells also cluster and mold but often form Homer Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and PHOX2B positivity; clinical history and markers separate them.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without molding and express TdT, CD34 and B/T markers.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells may show cytoplasmic vacuoles and multinucleation and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells often have PAS-positive cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles, are CD99/NKX2.2 positive and carry EWSR1 rearrangement.
